entities.name: Kaveri River water dispute
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The sharing of waters of the Kaveri river has been the source of conflict between the Indian states of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka. The 802 km (498 mi)–long Kaveri river originates at Talakaveri in the Western Ghats in Karnataka, and flows for about 320 km (200 mi) before entering Tamil Nadu. It flows further eastward in Tamil Nadu for 416 km (258 mi) before flowing into the Bay of Bengal near Poompuhar in Tamil Nadu. The basin area consists of 44,000 km2 in Tamil Nadu and 32,000 km2 in Karnataka.
